data.revised_prompt: Single clean reference sprite of a Codex app digital pet named Pup: friendly small dog, floppy ears, warm tan and white coat, tiny tail, expressive dark eyes, compact chibi digital pet. Pixel-art-adjacent low-resolution mascot sprite style, compact chibi proportions, chunky whole-body silhouette, thick dark 1–2 px outline, visible stepped/pixel edges, limited palette, flat cel shading with at most one small highlight and one shadow step, simple readable face, tiny limbs, no detail that disappears at 192x208. No polished illustration, no painterly rendering, no anime key art, no 3D render, no vector app-icon polish, no glossy lighting, no soft gradients, no realistic fur texture, no anti-aliased high-detail edges, no complex tiny accessories. Output exactly one centered full-body pet sprite pose only on a perfectly flat pure magenta #FF00FF chroma-key background. Pet fully visible and readable as tiny digital pet, suitable for animation into a 192x208 sprite cell. No scenery, text, labels, borders, checkerboard transparency, detached effects, shadows, glows, or extra props. Do not use #FF00FF or near-magenta colors in the pet.
